title: 5.8 Ordering Politely
unit_outcome: Express simple food preferences and needs and complete a supported purchase or café order.
goal: Complete a very short, highly supported café exchange using memorized polite chunks.
grammar_function: Item + please; receive with Here you are; respond with Thank you / Yes, please / No, thank you.
speaking_outcome: Say six polite service chunks, including a short request and thanks.

cards.pedagogy_note: New please request chunk; no Can I have yet.
New polite refusal; not a dislike claim.

cards.prompt: Hello. Water, please. Here you are. Thank you.

options.label: Hello. Water, please. Here you are. Thank you.

cards.spanish_translation: Hola. Agua, por favor. Aquí tienes. Gracias.
cards.pedagogy_note: Integrated model; audio uses brief natural pauses.
Speaker roles make only the learner's gratitude response valid; removes a plausible additional drink request.
Acceptance cue, item, and speaker role each eliminate a distractor; Thank you alone is removed because it could also accept politely.
Review tea; role and item are decisive.
Reviews greeting plus request; no image.
Generic proven instruction; scene establishes the opening turn.
Only please forms the taught request; Water, thank you was removed because it can also be a valid polite request.
Role contrast removes the plausible option of placing another order.
Visual turn context; no new offer wording.
Two-choice request completion removes Thank you, which can also be valid after an elliptical item request.
Reviews price; scene explicitly shows completed purchase rather than refusal.
